findings.statement: In v1, butter and milk are whisked into a frothy mixture before raw eggs are cracked into it and whisked together.
In v1, the combined egg mixture is poured into a heated pan and cooked until scrambled.
In v2, the displayed ingredients include two eggs, one tablespoon of butter, and half a cup of shredded cheese.
In v2, a yellow liquid is whisked in a metal bowl, and no additional ingredient is visibly added during that whisking interval.
In v2, a shredded orange and white ingredient is added on top of the cooking eggs and then fully mixed into the curds.

The videos differ in pre-cooking egg mixture: v1 mixes butter and milk into the eggs before cooking, while v2 shows no visible additional ingredient mixed during the observed whisking interval and adds a shredded ingredient during cooking.

open_questions.question: Whether the shredded orange and white ingredient added during cooking in v2 is the displayed shredded cheese remains unresolved.
Whether any ingredient, including the displayed butter, was added to the v2 eggs before the observed whisking interval remains unresolved.
